```{r}
library(MASS)
library(tidyverse)
library(lavaan)
library(lavaanPlot)

set.seed(42)
n_dyads <- 900

# List of partner-specific continuous variables
var_names <- c("sat", "prob", "bs", "hs", "work", "goodkids",
               "prio_rel", "cgd", "het_int", "prot_pat", "fin_stress", "house_stress")

# Construct variable names for women (_w) and men (_m)
all_vars <- c(paste0(var_names, "_w"), paste0(var_names, "_m"))
n_vars <- length(all_vars)

# Set neutral means for all variables (M = 0)
neutral_means <- setNames(rep(0, n_vars), all_vars)

cov_matrix <- diag(1, n_vars)
rownames(cov_matrix) <- colnames(cov_matrix) <- all_vars

for (v in var_names) {
  w_name <- paste0(v, "_w")
  m_name <- paste0(v, "_m")
  cov_matrix[w_name, m_name] <- 0.3
  cov_matrix[m_name, w_name] <- 0.3
}

# Generate raw continuous data (Standardized Z-scores)
raw_continuous <- mvrnorm(n = n_dyads, mu = neutral_means, Sigma = cov_matrix) %>% 
  as.data.frame()


# Dyad-Level Categorical Variables (Equal probability)
dyad_level <- tibble(
  dyad_id = 1:n_dyads,
  kids = sample(c("-1", "1"), size = n_dyads, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.5, 0.5)),
  cohabitating = sample(c("-1", "1"), size = n_dyads, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.5, 0.5))
)

# Combine into Wide Format
dyadic_wide <- bind_cols(dyad_level, raw_continuous)

# Reshape to Long Format
dyadic_long <- dyadic_wide %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(dyad_id, kids, cohabitating),
    names_to = c(".value", "gender"),
    names_pattern = "(.*)_(w|m)"
  ) %>%
  mutate(gender = if_else(gender == "w", "Woman", "Man"))

dyadic_wide$kids<- as.numeric(dyadic_wide$kids)
dyadic_wide$cohabitating<- as.numeric(dyadic_wide$cohabitating)
```


# Models 1-2

```{r}
dyadic_wide$BS_int<- dyadic_wide$bs_w * dyadic_wide$bs_m


mod.1 <- '
  # Structural model
  sat_m ~ bs_m + bs_w + BS_int + kids + cohabitating + hs_m + hs_w
  sat_w ~ bs_w + bs_m + BS_int + kids + cohabitating + hs_w + hs_m
  prob_m ~ bs_m + bs_w + BS_int + kids + cohabitating + hs_m + hs_w
  prob_w ~ bs_w + bs_m + BS_int + kids + cohabitating + hs_w + hs_m
  # Residual covariance
  sat_m ~~ sat_w
  prob_m ~~ prob_w
  sat_m ~~ prob_w
  sat_w ~~ prob_m
  sat_w ~~ prob_w
  sat_m ~~ prob_m

'


mod.2 <- '
  # Structural model
  house_stress_m ~ bs_m + bs_w + BS_int + kids + cohabitating + hs_m + hs_w
  house_stress_w ~ bs_w + bs_m + BS_int + kids + cohabitating + hs_w + hs_m
  fin_stress_m ~ bs_m + bs_w + BS_int + kids + cohabitating + hs_m + hs_w
  fin_stress_w ~ bs_w + bs_m + BS_int + kids + cohabitating + hs_w + hs_m

  # Residual covariance
  house_stress_m ~~ house_stress_w
  fin_stress_m ~~ fin_stress_w
  house_stress_m ~~ fin_stress_w
  house_stress_w ~~ fin_stress_m
  house_stress_m ~~ fin_stress_m
  house_stress_w ~~ fin_stress_w

'


```


# Model 3 Work Norms

```{r}
dyadic_wide$wbs_mwork<- dyadic_wide$bs_w * dyadic_wide$work_m
dyadic_wide$mbs_wwork<- dyadic_wide$bs_m * dyadic_wide$work_w

mod.3 <- '
  # Structural model
  sat_m ~ bs_m + bs_w + work_m + work_w + wbs_mwork + mbs_wwork + kids + cohabitating + hs_m + hs_w
  sat_w ~ bs_m + bs_w + work_m + work_w + wbs_mwork + mbs_wwork + kids + cohabitating + hs_m + hs_w
  prob_m ~ bs_m + bs_w + work_m + work_w + wbs_mwork + mbs_wwork + kids + cohabitating + hs_m + hs_w
  prob_w ~ bs_m + bs_w + work_m + work_w + wbs_mwork + mbs_wwork + kids + cohabitating + hs_m + hs_w

  # Residual covariance
  sat_m ~~ sat_w
  prob_m ~~ prob_w
  sat_m ~~ prob_w
  sat_w ~~ prob_m
  sat_w ~~ prob_w
  sat_m ~~ prob_m
  
'
  
```


# Models 4 Involvement with Children Norm

```{r}
dyadic_wide$mbs_wkids<- dyadic_wide$bs_m * dyadic_wide$goodkids_w
dyadic_wide$wbs_mkids<- dyadic_wide$bs_w * dyadic_wide$goodkids_m

mod.4 <- '
  # Structural model
  sat_m ~ bs_m + bs_w + goodkids_w + goodkids_m + mbs_wkids + wbs_mkids + kids + cohabitating + hs_m + hs_w
  sat_w ~ bs_m + bs_w + goodkids_w + goodkids_m + mbs_wkids + wbs_mkids + kids + cohabitating + hs_m + hs_w
  prob_m ~ bs_m + bs_w + goodkids_w + goodkids_m + mbs_wkids + wbs_mkids + kids + cohabitating + hs_m + hs_w
  prob_w ~ bs_m + bs_w + goodkids_w + goodkids_m + mbs_wkids + wbs_mkids + kids + cohabitating + hs_m + hs_w

  # Residual covariance
  sat_m ~~ sat_w
  prob_m ~~ prob_w
  sat_m ~~ prob_w
  sat_w ~~ prob_m
  sat_w ~~ prob_w
  sat_m ~~ prob_m
  
'

```


## Model 5

dyadic_wide$wbs_mRom<- dyadic_wide$bs_w * dyadic_wide$prio_rel_m

  sat_m ~ bs_m + bs_w + prio_rel_m + prio_rel_w + wbs_mRom + mbs_wRom + kids + cohabitating + hs_m + hs_w
  sat_w ~ bs_m + bs_w + prio_rel_m + prio_rel_w + wbs_mRom + mbs_wRom + kids + cohabitating + hs_m + hs_w
  prob_m ~ bs_m + bs_w + prio_rel_m + prio_rel_w + wbs_mRom + mbs_wRom + kids + cohabitating + hs_m + hs_w
  prob_w ~ bs_m + bs_w + prio_rel_m + prio_rel_w + wbs_mRom + mbs_wRom + kids + cohabitating + hs_m + hs_w
